name: Yungle
description: Share files as links from Yungle, an EU-hosted file transfer service, and answer questions about transfers, download receipts, collections and contacts. Emailing recipients needs a key with send permission and a confirmation on each send.
author: Brainpower

YUNGLE_API_KEY.description: Yungle API key, created under Settings → API keys at yungle.co. A read-only key is the safe default.
